plugins.name: mentor
plugins.description: A plugin-owned planning harness for Claude Code: fail-closed read-only planning (no native plan mode), with research and plan authoring delegated to subagents. The plan deliverable is user-configurable per repo — a bespoke styled-HTML review document (finalized to lean Markdown at approval) or a Mermaid-first Markdown document — shaped per domain.

plugins.name: sdlc-mini
plugins.description: Turbo SDLC helpers: a release-notes generator and a tidy commit helper. Manifest and env-config setup have moved to the devflow plugin; init-turbo-manifest and init-turbo-env-config remain as deprecated redirects.

plugins.name: plugin-ops
plugins.description: Plugin lifecycle tools for this marketplace: harvest a session into a new plugin, tune (audit/enhance) an existing one from a real session, and publish releases with synced manifests.
